verses.en: Now, behold, because of the thing which you, my servant Oliver Cowdery, have desired to know of me, I give unto you these words:
verses.sm: O Lenei, faauta, ona o le mea na manao mai ai oe, la’u auauna o Oliva Kaotui, e te fia iloa mai ia te a’u, Ou te tuu atu ai ia te oe upu nei:

verses.en: Behold, I have manifested unto you, by my Spirit in many instances, that the things which you have written are true; wherefore you know that they are true.
verses.sm: Faauta, sa Ou faaali atu ia te oe, i le tele o taimi, e ala i lo’u Agaga, o mea ia na e tusia ua moni; o le mea lea ua e iloa ai ua moni i latou.

verses.en: And if you know that they are true, behold, I give unto you a commandment, that you rely upon the things which are written;
verses.sm: Ma afai ua e iloa ua moni i latou, faauta, Ou te tuu atu ia te oe se poloaiga, ia e faalagolago i mea ua tusia;

verses.en: For in them are all things written concerning the foundation of my church, my gospel, and my rock.
verses.sm: Ona ua tusia i totonu o i latou mea uma e faatatau i le faavae o la’u ekalesia, la’u talalelei, ma la’u papa.

verses.en: Wherefore, if you shall build up my church, upon the foundation of my gospel and my rock, the gates of hell shall not prevail against you.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, afai e te ati a’e i luga la’u ekalesia, i luga o le faavae o la’u talalelei ma la’u papa, o le a lē manumalo faitotoa o seoli e faasaga ia te oe.

verses.en: Behold, the world is ripening in iniquity; and it must needs be that the children of men are stirred up unto repentance, both the Gentiles and also the house of Israel.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua matua le lalolagi i le amioleaga; ma ua ao ona fafagu i luga le fanauga a tagata ia salamo, o Nuuese atoa foi ma le aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Wherefore, as thou hast been baptized by the hands of my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., according to that which I have commanded him, he hath fulfilled the thing which I commanded him.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ona ua uma ona papatisoina oe i lima o la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e tusa ma lena mea na Ou poloaiina ai o ia, ua faataunuuina e ia le mea na Ou poloaiina ai o ia.

verses.en: And now, marvel not that I have called him unto mine own purpose, which purpose is known in me; wherefore, if he shall be diligent in keeping my commandments he shall be blessed unto eternal life; and his name is Joseph.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, aua le ofo ua Ou valaauina o ia mo lo’u lava faamoemoe, o se faamoemoe ua iloa e a’u; o le mea lea, afai e filiga o ia i le tausiga o a’u poloaiga o le a faamanuiaina o ia i le ola e faavavau; ma o lona igoa o Iosefa.

verses.en: And now, Oliver Cowdery, I speak unto you, and also unto David Whitmer, by the way of commandment; for, behold, I command all men everywhere to repent, and I speak unto you, even as unto Paul mine apostle, for you are called even with that same calling with which he was called.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, Oliva Kaotui e, Ou te tautala atu ia te oe, ma ia Tavita Uitimera foi, e ala i se poloaiga; aua, faauta, Ou te poloai atu i tagata uma i soo mea ia salamo, ma Ou te tautala atu ia te oulua, e pei ona fai ia Paulo la’u aposetolo, ona ua valaaulia oulua i lena lava valaauga e tasi na valaaulia i ai o ia.

verses.en: Remember the worth of souls is great in the sight of God;
verses.sm: Ia manatua ua tele lava le taua o agaga i le silafaga a le Atua;

verses.en: For, behold, the Lord your Redeemer suffered death in the flesh; wherefore he suffered the pain of all men, that all men might repent and come unto him.
verses.sm: Aua, faauta, na mafatia le Alii lo oulua Togiola i le oti i la le tino; o le mea lea na mafatia o ia i le tiga o tagata uma, ina ia mafai ona salamo tagata uma ma o mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And he hath risen again from the dead, that he might bring all men unto him, on conditions of repentance.
verses.sm: Ma ua toetu mai o ia mai le oti, ina ia mafai ona ia aumai o tagata uma ia te ia, i luga o tuutuuga o le salamo.

verses.en: And how great is his joy in the soul that repenteth!
verses.sm: Ma ua matua tele lava lona olioli i le agaga e salamo!

verses.en: Wherefore, you are called to cry repentance unto this people.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua valaaulia ai oulua e alaga atu le salamo i lenei nuu.

verses.en: And if it so be that you should labor all your days in crying repentance unto this people, and bring, save it be one soul unto me, how great shall be your joy with him in the kingdom of my Father!
verses.sm: Ma afai e faapea lua te galulue i o oulua aso uma i le alagaina o le salamo i lenei nuu, ma aumai, na o se agaga e toatasi ia te a’u, e matua tele lava lo oulua olioli faatasi ma ia i le malo o lo’u Tamā!

verses.en: And now, if your joy will be great with one soul that you have brought unto me into the kingdom of my Father, how great will be your joy if you should bring many souls unto me!
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, afai o le a tele lo oulua olioli faatasi ma se agaga e toatasi na oulua aumai ia te a’u i le malo o lo’u Tamā, e matua tele atu lo oulua olioli pe afai lua te aumai ni agaga e toatele ia te a’u!

verses.en: Behold, you have my gospel before you, and my rock, and my salvation.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua i o oulua luma la’u talalelei, ma la’u papa, ma la’u olataga.

verses.en: Ask the Father in my name in faith, believing that you shall receive, and you shall have the Holy Ghost, which manifesteth all things which are expedient unto the children of men.
verses.sm: Ole atu i le Tamā i lo’u igoa i le faatuatua, ma le talitonu o le a oulua maua, ma o le a oulua maua ai le Agaga Paia, lea na te faaali atu mea uma e tatau ai mo le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: And if you have not faith, hope, and charity, you can do nothing.
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē ia te oulua le faatuatua, faamoemoe, ma le alofa mama, e leai se mea lua te mafaia.

verses.en: Contend against no church, save it be the church of the devil.
verses.sm: Aua le finau faasaga atu i se ekalesia, vagana ai le ekalesia a le tiapolo.

verses.en: Take upon you the name of Christ, and speak the truth in soberness.
verses.sm: Ave i o oulua luga le suafa o Keriso, ma tautala atu le upumoni ma le faamaoni.

verses.en: And as many as repent and are baptized in my name, which is Jesus Christ, and endure to the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.sm: Ma o le toatele o e salamo ma papatiso i lo’u igoa, o Iesu Keriso lea, ma tumau e oo i le iuga, o i latou lava ia o le a faaolaina.

verses.en: Behold, Jesus Christ is the name which is given of the Father, and there is none other name given whereby man can be saved;
verses.sm: Faauta, o Iesu Keriso o le suafa lea ua tuu mai e le Tamā, ma ua leai se isi igoa ua tuu mai e mafai ona faaolaina ai le tagata;

verses.en: Wherefore, all men must take upon them the name which is given of the Father, for in that name shall they be called at the last day;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e ao i tagata uma ona latou ave i o latou luga le suafa ua tuu mai e le Tamā, ona o le suafa lena o le a valaau ai i latou i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: Wherefore, if they know not the name by which they are called, they cannot have place in the kingdom of my Father.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, afai latou te lē iloa le igoa e valaau ai i latou, e lē mafai ona latou maua se nofoaga i le malo o lo’u Tamā.

verses.en: And now, behold, there are others who are called to declare my gospel, both unto Gentile and unto Jew;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, e toatele isi o i ai ua valaaulia e talai atu la’u talalelei i Nuuese ma i Iutaia;

verses.en: Yea, even twelve; and the Twelve shall be my disciples, and they shall take upon them my name; and the Twelve are they who shall desire to take upon them my name with full purpose of heart.
verses.sm: Ioe, e toasefululua lava; ma o le Toasefululua o le a avea mo o’u soo, ma o le a latou ave i o latou luga lo’u igoa; ma o le Toasefululua o i latou ia o e o le a mananao latou te ave i o latou luga lo’u igoa ma le faamoemoe atoa o le loto.

verses.en: And if they desire to take upon them my name with full purpose of heart, they are called to go into all the world to preach my gospel unto every creature.
verses.sm: Ma afai latou te mananao latou te ave i o latou luga lo’u igoa ma le faamoemoe atoa o le loto, ua valaaulia i latou e o atu i le lalolagi atoa ma talai atu la’u talalelei i tagata uma.

verses.en: And they are they who are ordained of me to baptize in my name, according to that which is written;
verses.sm: Ma o i latou ia o i latou o e ua Ou faauuina e papatiso atu i lo’u igoa, e tusa ma mea ua tusia;

verses.en: And you have that which is written before you; wherefore, you must perform it according to the words which are written.
verses.sm: Ma ua i ai i o oulua luma ia mea ua tusia; o le mea lea, e ao ina oulua faia lenei mea e tusa ai ma upu ua tusia.

verses.en: And now I speak unto you, the Twelve—Behold, my grace is sufficient for you; you must walk uprightly before me and sin not.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te tautala atu ia te outou, le Toasefululua— Faauta, ua lava lo’u alofa tunoa mo outou; ia outou savavali sao i o’u luma ma ia lē agasala.

verses.en: And, behold, you are they who are ordained of me to ordain priests and teachers; to declare my gospel, according to the power of the Holy Ghost which is in you, and according to the callings and gifts of God unto men;
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, o outou ia o i latou o e ua faauuina ia te au e faauu ositaulaga ma aoao; e talai atu i tagata la’u talalelei, e tusa ma le mana o le Agaga Paia ua i totonu ia te outou, ma e tusa ai ma valaauga ma meaalofa a le Atua i tagata;

verses.en: And I, Jesus Christ, your Lord and your God, have spoken it.
verses.sm: Ma o A’u, o Iesu Keriso, lo outou Alii ma lo outou Atua, ua tautala atu i nei mea.

verses.en: These words are not of men nor of man, but of me; wherefore, you shall testify they are of me and not of man;
verses.sm: O nei upu ua lē mai tagata pe mai se tagata, ae ua mai ia te a’u; o le mea lea, ia outou molimau atu o nei upu ua mai ia te a’u ae ua lē mai i se tagata;

verses.en: For it is my voice which speaketh them unto you; for they are given by my Spirit unto you, and by my power you can read them one to another; and save it were by my power you could not have them;
verses.sm: Aua o lo’u leo lea o loo tautala atu ia upu ia te outou; ona ua tuu i latou e lo’u Agaga ia te outou, ma e mafai ona outou faitauina i latou o le tasi i le isi e ala i lo’u mana; ma e lē mafai ona outou mauaina i latou vagana ai e ala i lo’u mana;

verses.en: Wherefore, you can testify that you have heard my voice, and know my words.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e mafai ona outou molimau atu sa outou faalogo i lo’u leo, ma iloa a’u upu.

verses.en: And now, behold, I give unto you, Oliver Cowdery, and also unto David Whitmer, that you shall search out the Twelve, who shall have the desires of which I have spoken;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, Ou te tuu atu ia te oe, Oliva Kaotui, ma ia Tavita Uitimera foi, ia oulua saili mai le Toasefululua, o e o le a i ai manaoga ia na Ou tautala atu ai;

verses.en: And by their desires and their works you shall know them.
verses.sm: Ma o o latou manaoga ma a latou galuega o le a oulua iloa ai i latou.

verses.en: And when you have found them you shall show these things unto them.
verses.sm: Ma a oulua maua i latou, ia oulua faaali atu nei mea ia te i latou.

verses.en: And you shall fall down and worship the Father in my name.
verses.sm: Ma ia oulua faapa’u’ū i lalo ma ifo atu i le Tamā i lo’u igoa.

verses.en: And you must preach unto the world, saying: You must repent and be baptized, in the name of Jesus Christ;
verses.sm: Ma e ao ina oulua talai atu i le lalolagi, fai atu: E ao ina outou salamo ma papatiso, i le suafa o Iesu Keriso;

verses.en: For all men must repent and be baptized, and not only men, but women, and children who have arrived at the years of accountability.
verses.sm: Ona e ao i tagata uma ona salamo ma papatiso, ma e lē na o tane, ae o fafine, ma tamaiti o e ua oo i tausaga e tatau ai.

verses.en: And now, after that you have received this, you must keep my commandments in all things;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, a uma ona oulua maua o lenei faaaliga, e ao ina oulua tausi i a’u poloaiga i mea uma;

verses.en: And by your hands I will work a marvelous work among the children of men, unto the convincing of many of their sins, that they may come unto repentance, and that they may come unto the kingdom of my Father.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou galueaiina se galuega ofoofogia i totonu o le fanauga a tagata e ala atu i o oulua lima, mo le faatalitonuina o le toatele e uiga ia latou agasala, ina ia latou salamo, ma ina ia latou o mai i le malo o lo’u Tamā.

verses.en: Wherefore, the blessings which I give unto you are above all things.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o faamanuiaga ua Ou tuu atu ia te oulua ua silisili atu i luga o mea uma.

verses.en: And after that you have received this, if you keep not my commandments you cannot be saved in the kingdom of my Father.
verses.sm: Ma a uma ona oulua maua lenei faaaliga, afai lua te lē tausi i a’u poloaiga e lē mafai ona faaolaina oulua i le malo o lo’u Tamā.

verses.en: Behold, I, Jesus Christ, your Lord and your God, and your Redeemer, by the power of my Spirit have spoken it. Amen.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o Iesu Keriso, lo oulua Alii ma lo oulua Atua, ma lo oulua Togiola, o le mana o lo’u Agaga ua Ou tautala atu ai. Amene.
